note: Curated demo-clip allow-list. Every clip Spotter shows in the Explain sheet comes from one of these creators; nothing is taken from YouTube search. To add a creator, add one entry here and run 'node tools/demo-videos.mjs run' — the enumerator, the matcher, the review file and the SQL do not change. Fields: uploads:true enumerates the channel's uploads playlist (UU + channel_id minus the UC); playlists[] enumerates exactly those playlist ids; playlists_tab is a regex over the channel's playlists tab, for a creator who files demos in many small playlists; manual points at a hand-pasted file for clips that are unlisted and cannot be enumerated. select is the gate a video has to pass to be considered at all (max_secs, optional min_secs, optional title_re, plain_title = the title has to read like a bare exercise name, max_words). strip is applied in order to the title before matching and before the title is shown. tier orders creators when several have the same exercise: 1 wins.

sources.label: Jeff Nippard
sources.why: Technique Tuesday is a deep dive, not a demo clip, and every title is a hook. It is offered as the go-deeper alternate, never as an automatic match: containment and the review file only.
